# phasetwo_realm (Data Source)

An existing realm on a dedicated cluster.

Give either `id`, or `cluster_id` together with `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phasetwo_realm" "app" {
  cluster_id = data.phasetwo_cluster.existing.id
  name       = "app"
}

output "realm_state" {
  value = data.phasetwo_realm.app.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the cluster the realm runs on. Required with `name`.
- `id` (String) ID of the realm. Set this, or `cluster_id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the realm. Requires `cluster_id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `region` (String) Region of the hosting cluster.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state.
- `state_error` (String) Why the realm last failed.
